summary: Devon Energy Corp. files an 8-K regarding its pending acquisition of Coterra Energy Inc. via a merger structured for Merger Sub to merge with & into Coterra, with Coterra surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Terms beyond the stock consideration structure are not detailed here. The S-4 registration statement has been declared effective and a joint proxy/prospectus filed. Special shareholder meetings are scheduled for May 4, 2026. The filing also discloses two shareholder lawsuits and multiple demand letters alleging disclosure deficiencies in the proxy statement. Watch for resolution of litigation and shareholder vote outcome for the risk-arb spread.
